tasks.label: Clean .scadbak backups
tasks.detail: Delete every scadformat backup file under the workspace
tasks.command: find '${workspaceFolder}' -type f -name '*.scadbak' -print -delete | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo 'removed {} .scadbak file(s)'

tasks.label: Clean 3D printer exports
tasks.detail: Delete every .stl and .3mf export under the workspace
tasks.command: find '${workspaceFolder}' -type f \( -name '*.stl' -o -name '*.3mf' \) -print -delete | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo 'removed {} printer file(s)'
